Selz Capital Has Raised Shire Plc Sponsored Adr (SHPG) Holding by $2.67 Million; Summit Securities Group Has Trimmed Its Kinder Morgan Del (KMI) Holding as Market Valuation Declined
May 1, 2018 - By Adrian Mccoy
Bernard Selz increased its stake in Shire Plc Sponsored Adr (SHPG) by 19.07% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Selz Capital Llc bought 17,200 shares as the company’s stock declined 17.82% with the market. The hedge fund run by Bernard Selz held 107,400 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $16.66M, up from 90,200 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Selz Capital Llc who had been investing in Shire Plc Sponsored Adr for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $47.24B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.38% or $2.23 during the last trading session, reaching $159.43. About 1.42 million shares traded. Shire plc (NASDAQ:SHPG) has declined 27.67% since May 1, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 39.22% the S&P500.
Summit Securities Group Llc decreased its stake in Kinder Morgan Inc Del (KMI) by 41.27% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Summit Securities Group Llc sold 20,100 shares as the company’s stock declined 16.40% with the market. The institutional investor held 28,600 shares of the public utilities company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $517,000, down from 48,700 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Summit Securities Group Llc who had been investing in Kinder Morgan Inc Del for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $34.90B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.82% or $0.13 during the last trading session, reaching $15.82. About 14.20 million shares traded. Kinder Morgan, Inc. (NYSE:KMI) has declined 28.25% since May 1, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 39.80% the S&P500.
Selz Capital Llc, which manages about $474.62 million and $675.94 million US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Colony Northstar Inc by 439,000 shares to 151,000 shares, valued at $1.72M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Chemours Co Com by 30,000 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 61,000 shares, and cut its stake in Ticc Capital Corp Com (NASDAQ:TICC).
Among 28 analysts covering Shire plc (ADR) ( NASDAQ:SHPG ), 23 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 5 Hold. Therefore 82% are positive. Shire plc (ADR) had 79 analyst reports since July 22, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The stock has “Buy” rating by RBC Capital Markets on Wednesday, June 7. As per Friday, May 26, the company rating was downgraded by Bernstein. Susquehanna maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Friday, February 16 report. The stock of Shire plc (NASDAQ:SHPG) has “Hold” rating given on Thursday, July 6 by HSBC. On Friday, January 5 the stock rating was maintained by Cowen & Co with “Buy”. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Thursday, May 26 by Stifel Nicolaus. The stock of Shire plc (NASDAQ:SHPG) has “Buy” rating given on Friday, April 20 by RBC Capital Markets. The stock of Shire plc (NASDAQ:SHPG) has “Buy” rating given on Tuesday, November 14 by Liberum Capital. The stock has “Buy” rating by RBC Capital Markets on Monday, October 2. On Friday, June 30 the stock rating was maintained by Cantor Fitzgerald with “Buy”.
Summit Securities Group Llc, which manages about $840.93 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 567,622 shares to 568,000 shares, valued at $96.12 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Seagate Technology Plc (NASDAQ:STX) by 22,032 shares in the quarter, for a total of 22,100 shares, and has risen its stake in Johnson And Johnson (NYSE:JNJ).
